g.text: The CUDA stack: what sits between torch.matmul and the silicon

text.tspan: 1 · FRAMEWORKS AND ENGINES (you write Python here)
PyTorch eager and torch.compile · JAX · vLLM · SGLang · TensorRT-LLM · Dynamo
2 · KERNEL LANGUAGES (how new kernels get written)
CUDA C++ · CUTLASS / CuTe DSL · cuTile Python · OpenAI Triton · third-party: FlashAttention, DeepGEMM, TileLang
cuBLAS / cuBLASLt (matmul) · cuDNN · NCCL (multi-GPU) · TensorRT · thousands of tuned kernel variants
4 · CUDA RUNTIME AND DRIVER APIs (user space)
cudart: memory, streams, CUDA Graphs, kernel launch · libcuda: module loading, PTX JIT, contexts
nvcc → NVVM (LLVM) → PTX virtual ISA → ptxas → SASS machine code → fatbinary (SASS per GPU + PTX)
GPU kernel module · GSP firmware · page tables, scheduling, error handling
SMs run warps of 32 threads · Tensor Cores · HBM · NVLink
PTX shipped inside an app can be
for a GPU that did not exist
